paragraphs: Rava son of Rabbah. He sent to Rav Yosef, ‘Let our teacher instruct us’: Shabbat 123a; Yevamot 76a. ‘Anyone who loves to learn among a multitude,’ etc.; the rabbis set their eyes upon Rava son of Rabbah: Makkot 10a. See Rabbah son of Rava. Unqualified Rabbah is bar Nahmani; thus this Rava is Rabbah bar Nahmani's son, and is not the Rava mentioned just before, son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna, since in the aforementioned places they call that man ‘son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna.’ Yuhasin forgot to mention him, or thought they were one, with no second person.
